name: claude-seo-unified
description: Unified SEO/GEO/AEO plugin for Claude Code, merged from four MIT-licensed source projects (see /NOTICE.md for full provenance). Base audit engine and 24 core sub-skills from AgriciDaniel/claude-seo (technical SEO, schema, local, ecommerce, hreflang, backlinks, drift monitoring, Google APIs, PDF/Excel reporting). Adds: an opt-in dry-run/git-aware fixer (seo-fix) with AI-crawler robots.txt presets and a confidence-tiered finding schema ported from Hainrixz/claude-seo-ai; an actively-corrected, dated GEO/AEO statistics and platform-citation reference, plus entity/knowledge-graph, social-preview, and voice-search guides, ported from 199-biotechnologies/claude-skill-seo-geo-optimizer; content-strategy, competitor-profiling, and programmatic-SEO business-context layers merged from coreyhaines31/marketingskills into existing skills; and a new App Store Optimization skill (seo-aso), also from coreyhaines31/marketingskills, covering the App Store/Google Play ranking surface. Every audit skill remains strictly read-only; only seo-fix, after explicit user confirmation, can write.
